items.title: Loren Schoenberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019
items.q: when Vladimir Horowitz comes out to play... they don’t go to the microphone and say, I hope you like this little tune by Schubert

ctx.x: But they’re not really coalescing here but somehow, so when I say there’s nothing to understand about jazz, so then you have some responsibility also on the part of the musicians. Now a musician might say, a jazz musician might say, when Vladimir Horowitz comes out to play, or the Juilliard String Quartet, they don’t go to the microphone and say, I hope you like this little tune by Schubert, you know when he wrote it I have a funny story about it and all that kind of — so they just play. But by mimicking the…
When we do Part Two of this interview, we’ll reflect on that.
